name: Sunnyside & Woodside Mutual Aid — Bliss Plaza Pantry
description: Neighborhood mutual-aid group providing food relief and operating pop-up pantries.
acceptance_note: Community-confirmed donation recipient. Coordinate with the group before bringing perishable produce.
operating_information: Pop-up pantry listed Thursday, 1:15–2:15 PM; schedule may change.

name: Astoria Food Pantry
description: Community-run food pantry, free store, community fridges, and mutual-aid space.
acceptance_note: Official site says food donations are accepted anytime the pantry is open. Confirm perishable produce before travel.
operating_information: Donation hours vary by day; check the official site before visiting.

name: Friendly Fridge BX
description: Bronx community food hub that rescues and redirects food from neighbors, farms, markets, and food businesses.
acceptance_note: Official site identifies fresh produce as a donation and food-redirection resource. Confirm large drop-offs first.
operating_information: Food hub hours listed Tuesday and Thursday at 2 PM.

name: Fulton Street Community Fridge
description: Community fridge connected with Clinton Hill Fort Greene Mutual Aid.
acceptance_note: The fridge publishes food-donation guidance. Review its current guidelines before donating.
operating_information: Outdoor community fridge hosted in front of Key Food; check current guidance before visiting.
